summary: Carded off the bench session: the Character Sheet head-removal branch is a BiRefNet matte minus the SAM3 head mask composited onto a flat #808080 plate, replacing a full Klein 4B edit pass.
Sync of the rebaked workflow starting; graph verified clean against the app engine before any repo write.

Workflow synced and gated before any repo write - bench and app engine both 0.31.0, dry conversion exit 0, verify-workflow and validate-injection-rules both green, and the shipped twin came out byte-identical to that dry run. 94 nodes -> 66. Descriptor down to the one Krea 2 slot; SAM3 and BiRefNet are both engineAsset so neither is a flow requirement. 747/747, eslint clean, flow-lora-button desktop spec passing.

FINDING: the Character Sheet was the LAST two-slot flow in the repo - every shipped flow now declares exactly one model slot. The multi-slot machinery (flowModelChoices, per-slot picks, per-phase racks, MpiBaseFlow cogwheel loop) is live code with no shipped caller exercising more than one slot, which is why removing one slot broke eight tests at once. Coverage KEPT on a synthetic TWO_SLOT_FIXTURE rather than deleted; MPI-586 Prop Sheet needs the same shape. Casualty: the Library detail panel multi-slot RENDER has no desktop probe any more, and a fixture flow is the wrong fix there because a missing tile preview 404s the suite.
Every implementation item ticked. Only the two visual gates remain open.

Both visual gates answered yes by Fabio: the BiRefNet hair matte holds at 100% on the portrait panel, and the hard-edged GrowMask 6 neck cut needs no feather back - a subtraction does not want the slack an inpaint did.

Gates section closed. Card closes on: workflow gated before any repo write, shipped twin byte-identical to the verified dry run, 94 nodes -> 66, descriptor down to the one Krea 2 slot, 747/747 + eslint clean + desktop spec passing, and both visual gates passed.
